why_batched_is_the_standard_now: A single full run cannot finish on this host: it reaches 100% and is then killed before printing a summary, because the host's bulk-delete guard intercepts pytest's own cleanup of accumulated temp garbage (measured twice -- SAFE_DELETE_BULK_GUARD_ERROR exit 0xC0000142, and SAFE_DELETE_BULK_CONFIRM_REQUIRED count=196 threshold=50). Batching with a fresh basetemp per batch removes the garbage pytest would try to delete, and every batch then reports its own summary, which is what makes an aggregate verdict possible at all.
